avis.titre: Removes Makeup Easily, Works Great w/ My Sensitive
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using this product. It definitely removed my makeup with ease - I soaked a cotton ball and wiped softly away as described on the instructions and I was surprised with how easily my makeup was removed without having to continuously scrub! Especially with my overnight caked-on mascara and eyeliner. I also have very sensitive skin and eyes, but I didn't experience any discomfort while using this product. The only fault I would mention, which also brought me to use the 4-star rating, is that it was a bit drying on my skin. However, I have very dry skin as is, and even plain water will dry me out if I don't instantly moisturize. Overall, I would recommend others to use this product, especially if they are looking for something to remove makeup easily without scrubbing and if they have sensitive skin and/or eyes. I am happy with the product and will continue using for sure!

This product is different. My skins feels soft and CLEAN after I use it and it takes off my makeup with little scrubbing. It also leaves my face feeling hydrated, which is so important in the winter. It also helps that it smells amazing - lightly floral but not overwhelming - just enough to feel refreshed. Overall, I like this product as a gentle alternative to other makeup removers. The only issue I have is that it isn't as good for removing waterproof makeup.
Gets my face clean from the makeup and refreshes my face. I would recommend to others.
